text:
Maria: handing off to @Ajay for the overnight window. Quick summary of what changed in the last shift:
- rolling change: routing policy updated at 21:10 -> cost-tier fallback enabled for low-priority requests
- config: prefetch TTL reduced from 60s -> 30s in prod to lower memory pressure
- infra: applied a Redis replica failover in eu-west at 20:48 (recovery completed)
What to watch:
- KV eviction rate in Redis (console metric: redis.evictions/s). If > 12/s sustained for > 5m escalate and scale dedicated pool.
- Latency spikes in eu-west (p50/p95). We saw a transient p95 bump to ~480ms during failover; currently back to baseline ~120ms.
Action items for overnight:
- Ajay: monitor evictions + run the recovery script only if evict>12/s for 5m (command below).
- Tim/Jen: PR follow-up on prioritizer PRs (see PRs list).
- Sara: I'll hand over morning watch to you at 08:00.
If anything looks suspicious, page, otherwise leave notes here. :thumbsup:

Ajay: ack, will take it. I set a dashboard alert at 10 evict/s for now to give an earlier heads up. If it trips I'll check evictions and KV hit-rate first.

Tim: FYI I noticed flake in prioritizer when running loadtest-2.0, might be related to the new routing config. Filed PR comments on 4321. Pinging @Jen for a quick rebase.

Jen: on it — I will rebase PR 4321 and add a tiny integration test. ETA ~45m.

Ajay: quick question — if eviction does cross threshold, do we prefer scaling dedicated pool or bumping eviction TTL back to 60s?

Maria: prefer scale first (automated scaling is faster for this case), TTL rollback only if scaling doesn't help or if we see thrashing.

OncallBot: scheduled maintenance reminder: infra patch window tomorrow 03:00-03:45 UTC for control-plane nodes. No changes to inference pools expected.

Sara: noted, I'll watch the early morning window. Also I'm covering 08:00-12:00 tomorrow so ping me for the 08:00 handoff.

Ajay: recovery command snippet (only run if evict > threshold and after confirming with oncall):
```bash
# restore kv shards for eu-west
./scripts/restore_kv.sh --region eu-west --confirm
```
Do not run during heavy traffic.

Tim: small operational note — two PRs need quick reviews: 4321 (prioritizer) and 4330 (batching tweak). If you can glance tonight, that'd be great, otherwise I'll merge tomorrow morning after Jen's rebase.

Maria: thanks everyone. Leaving my watch handover notes in the runbook channel too. Ajay — ping here if you want me to stay on call for 15m after any paging. Good night. :wave:
